Philosophy and Goals of the Core Curriculum


The University’s educational mission lives in its Core Curriculum. The Core is designed and organized to foster Encouragement of Learning, the Jesuit, Marymount, and CSJ values of the Core ensure Education of the Whole Person, and the Core inspires students to become persons in Service of Faith and committed to the Promotion of Justice. 


The LMU Core is organized across three levels – Foundations, Explorations, and Integrations. The Foundations courses (see below) introduce students to the intellectual traditions of the Academy and LMU. Students are guided through six courses to understand, appreciate, and analyze key issues in philosophy, theology, ethnic studies, STEM fields, rhetoric, with an emphasis on developing fundamental communication skills. Explorations courses encourage students to engage in different disciplinary methods and perspectives of the humanities, arts, natural sciences, and social sciences. Integrations courses challenge students to take learned skills and knowledge from the Foundation and Exploration courses, together with their majors, and apply them to interdisciplinary consideration of thematic questions. This area is typically fulfilled during the student's junior and senior years (Years 3 and 4) as part of their Upper Division coursework at LMU.

Transfer students can meet Foundations and Explorations Core requirements by taking one course for each area:


FOUNDATIONS (Years 1-2)

Complete one course in each of the following:

  • FFYS - First Year Seminar (Year 1)
  • FRTA - Rhetorical Arts (Year 1)
  • FQTR - Quantitative Reasoning
  • FTHI - Theological Inquiry
  • FPHI - Philosophical Inquiry
  • FDIV - Studies in American Diversity


EXPLORATIONS (Years 2-3)

Complete one course in each of the following:

  • ECRE - Creative Experience
  • EHAP - Historical Analysis and Perspectives
  • ESTM - Nature of Science, Technology, and Mathematics
  • EHBV - Understanding Human Behavior


INTERGRATIONS (year 3-4) must be taken at LMU**

  • IFTR - Faith and Reason
  • IEJT - Ethics and Justice
  • IINC - Interdisciplinary Connections


Note

Transfer students who enter LMU with 31 units or more may choose to waive either of the following Core requirements:

  • FFYS - First Year Seminar
  • FRTA - Rhetorical Arts

﻿

Transfer students who enter LMU with 55 units or more will have the following Core requirements waived:

  • FPHI - Philosophical Inquiry
  • FTHI - Theological Inquiry
